title: vcw-online-1995-world-heavyweight
label: Blind Melon Chitlin

won.source: The community's own Hall of Fame nomination threads (22 September and 22 November 1997) credit him retrospectively: 'BMC was possibly the best "monster heel" of 1996 in the SWA. Held VCW World Heavyweight Title, I-C Title, and 6-Man Title (with others).'

note: Must have ended before 26 August 1996, when the fed's own newsletter first attests the Purple Haze as champion; no document in the held record narrates the change.

title: vcw-online-1995-world-heavyweight
label: the Purple Haze

won.source: Billed as VCW's own reigning World Heavyweight Champion on VCW Online #69 (26 August 1996), previewed there defending the belt the same week against 'the reformed General Failure, now calling himself Red "Union" Steele'; still billed and reconfirmed as champion ('the Haze is VCW world champion') on VCW Online #70, 'Fall From Grace' (5 September 1996). No document in the held record narrates when or how he won the title.

note: The last VCW World Heavyweight sighting of any kind in the held record; his own title defense against Red "Union" Steele, previewed for the same week, does not itself survive.

title: vcw-online-1995-intercontinental
label: Blind Melon Chitlin

won.source: The community's own Hall of Fame nomination threads (22 September and 22 November 1997), credited alongside his World Heavyweight and Six-Man Tag reigns.

note: No successor or end date is attested anywhere in the held record.

title: vcw-online-1995-six-man-tag
label: Blind Melon Chitlin

won.source: The community's own Hall of Fame nomination threads (22 September and 22 November 1997): 'Held VCW World Heavyweight Title, I-C Title, and 6-Man Title (with others).'

note: Held '(with others)' per the source's own phrasing; no document in the held record names his co-holders. A 22 September 1997 community post separately mentions an unnamed handler's own tag team as 'three time VCW Tag Team Champions' and another as 'two thirds of the VCW Six Man Tag champs,' but names neither the team nor its members, so no further reign or holder is structured from it.

title: vcw-online-1995-light-heavyweight
label: Johnny Dominant

won.source: The community's own RSPWF Top 75 rankings of 19 October 1995 rank him #14; the community's own Hall of Fame nomination threads (22 September and 22 November 1997) describe the Light Heavyweight title as currently 'held by Johnny Dominant.'

note: No successor is attested anywhere in the held record.
